title: Packwerk Package
markdownDescription:
Configuration for a Packwerk package, a modular unit that enforces dependency boundaries in Ruby applications. Place `package.yml` in any folder to define it as a package. Used to prevent your codebase from becoming a "ball of mud" by enforcing explicit dependencies.

[Packwerk Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/packwerk/blob/main/USAGE.md)

metadata.markdownDescription:
Custom metadata about package ownership and stewardship. Not validated by Packwerk, so can contain any information. Commonly includes team ownership, Slack channels, or other organizational data.

**Example:**
```yaml
metadata:
  stewards:
    - "@Shopify/sales"
  slack_channels:
    - "#sales"
```

[Package Metadata Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/packwerk/blob/main/USAGE.md#package-metadata)

enforce_dependencies.markdownDescription:
Enable dependency boundary enforcement for this package. When enabled, references to constants in undeclared dependencies cause violations. **Default:** `false`

- `true`: Enforce dependencies, allow recording violations in `package_todo.yml`
- `"strict"`: Prevent new violations from being added to `package_todo.yml`
- `false`: Don't enforce dependency boundaries

**Example:**
```yaml
enforce_dependencies: true
dependencies:
  - components/platform
```
markdownEnumDescriptions: Strict mode - prevents new violations from being added to package_todo.yml. New violations will cause errors instead of being recorded.

dependencies.markdownDescription:
List of packages that this package is allowed to depend on. Package paths are relative to the project root. Only checked when `enforce_dependencies` is enabled.

**Example:**
```yaml
dependencies:
  - components/platform
  - components/shared
```

enforce_privacy.markdownDescription:
Enable privacy enforcement for this package. References from other packages to constants outside the public folder cause violations.

- `true`: Enforce, allow recording violations in `package_todo.yml`
- `"strict"`: Prevent new violations from being added to `package_todo.yml`
- `false`: Don't enforce

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
enforce_privacy: true
```

public_path.markdownDescription:
Folder holding this package's public API, relative to the package root.

**Default:** `app/public/`

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
public_path: lib/public/
```

private_constants.markdownDescription:
Only enforce privacy on these constants instead of everything outside the public folder. Requires `enforce_privacy`.

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
private_constants:
  - "::Billing::Internal"
```

ignored_private_constants.markdownDescription:
Private constants that do not cause privacy violations.

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
ignored_private_constants:
  - "::Billing::LegacyInvoice"
```

strict_privacy_ignored_patterns.markdownDescription:
File patterns whose privacy violations are allowed when `enforce_privacy` is `"strict"`.

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
strict_privacy_ignored_patterns:
  - engines/other_engine/test/**/*
```

enforce_visibility.markdownDescription:
Enable visibility enforcement for this package. Only packages listed in `visible_to` may reference it.

- `true`: Enforce, allow recording violations in `package_todo.yml`
- `"strict"`: Prevent new violations from being added to `package_todo.yml`
- `false`: Don't enforce

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
enforce_visibility: true
visible_to:
  - components/checkout
```

visible_to.markdownDescription:
Packages allowed to reference this package when `enforce_visibility` is enabled.

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
visible_to:
  - components/checkout
```

enforce_folder_privacy.markdownDescription:
Only allow this package to be referenced by its parent and sibling packages.

- `true`: Enforce, allow recording violations in `package_todo.yml`
- `"strict"`: Prevent new violations from being added to `package_todo.yml`
- `false`: Don't enforce

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
enforce_folder_privacy: true
```

layer.markdownDescription:
The layer this package belongs to. Must be one of the `layers` in `packwerk.yml`. Packages may only depend on packages in the same or a lower layer.

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
layer: utility
```

enforce_layers.markdownDescription:
Enable layer enforcement for this package.

- `true`: Enforce, allow recording violations in `package_todo.yml`
- `"strict"`: Prevent new violations from being added to `package_todo.yml`
- `false`: Don't enforce

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
enforce_layers: true
layer: product
```

enforce_architecture.markdownDescription:
Enable layer enforcement for this package, when `packwerk.yml` uses the legacy `architecture_layers` key.

- `true`: Enforce, allow recording violations in `package_todo.yml`
- `"strict"`: Prevent new violations from being added to `package_todo.yml`
- `false`: Don't enforce

Requires [packwerk-extensions](https://github.com/rubyatscale/packwerk-extensions).

**Example:**
```yaml
enforce_architecture: true
layer: product
```
enforce_architecture.deprecationMessage: Rename `architecture_layers` to `layers` in packwerk.yml and use `enforce_layers`.
